label: 容器信息
js: (() => { const cc=document.querySelector('.canvas-container'); const root=cc && cc.parentElement; const up=document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas'); const b=up.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ hasContainer: !!cc, rootTag: root && root.tagName, rootIsListener: root ? root.style.position === 'relative' : false, upRect: [Math.round(b.left), Math.round(b.top), Math.round(b.width), Math.round(b.height)] }) })()

label: 直接向容器派发 dblclick
js: (() => { const cc=document.querySelector('.canvas-container'); const root=cc && cc.parentElement; if(!root) return 'no-root'; const up=document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas'); const b=up.getBoundingClientRect(); const x=b.left+240, y=b.top+220; root.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,clientX:x,clientY:y,detail:2,button:0})); return 'sent@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y) })()
